resources.string: ScreenLife is a research application that systematically captures and analyzes smartphone usage patterns through periodic screenshots. All collected data is encrypted using industry-standard protocols before secure transmission to our research infrastructure.\n\nThis application is strictly for authorized research participants. If you have not provided formal consent to participate in this research study, please uninstall this application immediately.
